[LSCP.2.5.1] Facts are read-only from rule code. Rule LHSs may
pattern-match on them; rule RHSs must not `emit` or `withdraw`
them. The compiler must reject any `emit` or `withdraw` action
targeting a `scope <base> ambient` schema in a rule's RHS.

The error message names the schema and points the author at
emitting a request schema (e.g. `LightRequest`) instead.
